rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the presidential speech headed as delivered at the National Council session at Gandhi Nagar on '3rd and 4th May, 1998', Kushabhau Thakre says 'a karyakarta like me has been entrusted with the responsibility of heading the party at this juncture' and 'I sincerely thank the entire party for electing me unanimously'.

locator.section: heading 'Presidential speech of Kushabhau Thakre, delivered on the occasion of BJP NATIONAL COUNCIL SESSION at Gandhi Nagar (Gujarat) 3rd and 4th May, 1998'; paragraph containing 'electing me unanimously'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same speech Thakre says 'I assume this office by saluting the sacred memory of our founder, Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee, and the source of our inspiration and ideological guidance, Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya'.

locator.section: paragraph containing 'I assume this office by saluting'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same speech Thakre says the founders' ideals 'shall be my beacon as I discharge my duties as the President of this party of Syama Prasad Mookerjee and Deendayal Upadhyaya'.

locator.section: paragraph containing 'as I discharge my duties as the President of this party'
